brief: A single clinical treatment room with the dental chair in the middle of the floor. It faces the window wall, and the overhead lamp and instrument tray sit beside it. A white run of cabinets and drawers with a white stone worktop, sink and under-cabinet LED strip fills the left wall. A wall-mounted x-ray monitor hangs above the worktop. A mobile drawer cabinet stands on the right with a teal tray on top. A teal operator stool on casters sits by the cabinets, and a pale guest chair stands in the corner. Light is clean, cool and even, from ceiling panels and a frosted-bottom window. The mood is calm and sterile. Surfaces hold only dispensers, instrument trays, a small potted plant by the window and one pale framed print.

must_have.where: centre of room, head toward the back wall, instrument tray to the right, lamp overhead
teal operator stool on casters beside the cabinet run on the left
continuous white base and wall cabinets with sink on the left wall, plus a mobile drawer unit on the right
on the wall beside the dental chair

concept: A sterile, daylit clinical room in white, pale grey and a single teal accent. Upholstery, trays and stool share the teal, and the clean cool light makes every surface read as hygienic.
relations: White walls, white cabinetry and pale grey resilient floor + cool 4500-5000K flush ceiling panels + daylight from the window = bright, hygienic, shadow-free clinical feel
One teal accent repeated on chair upholstery, stool, trays and dispensers ties the equipment together against the neutral white shell
Low density: one chair and the stool in the open centre, cabinets pushed to the walls = clear circulation and easy cleaning
Under-cabinet LED strip + operating lamp give task light over the worktop and the patient, on top of even ambient light
Minimal decor (one plant, one pale print) softens the clinical room without adding clutter
not_reproducible: The x-ray image on the monitor, the hoses and handpieces, the overhead articulated lamp arm detail, the instruments on the tray, the soap and hand-sanitiser bottles, the tree view through the window, and the door in the foreground.
